svg.title: Do not merge these three radii
svg.desc: Three concentric circles have coordinate radii in the ratio two to three to six. Circle radii are proportional to the Schwarzschild areal coordinate r. The drawing is a radial coordinate guide, not an isometric picture of spatial proper distances.

g.text: 28 / DO NOT MERGE THESE THREE RADII
For a nonrotating, uncharged black hole.
